description: This file defines a JavaScript module that sets up and manages a Supabase client for the Learning Management System web application. It includes functions to resolve environment variables for configuration, lazily initialize the singleton client, fetch user session and profile data, and determine the site redirect URL.

methods.name: resolveSupabaseEnv()
methods.description: Resolves environment variables for Supabase URL and key, supporting multiple naming conventions to ensure compatibility across different environments.

methods.name: getOrCreateClient()
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the singleton Supabase client, stored on the global window object to maintain a single instance during hot module reloading.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Exports the singleton method to access the Supabase client, ensuring it's initialized before use.

methods.name: getSessionAndProfile()
methods.description: Fetches the current user session and profile data from Supabase, creating a profile if missing, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: getSiteRedirectUrl()
methods.description: Returns the site URL used for authentication redirects, defaulting to environment variable or window location origin.
